title: Power Pages: OpenID Connect sign-in accepts encrypted ID tokens
summary: The roadmap dates, automatic enablement and existing authentication controls are supported. Searches found no Power Pages documentation for the encrypted-token settings or feature-specific licensing. Clarify that the existing governance control restricts the protocol rather than selectively controlling token encryption.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls: final sentence
claims.claim: The documented governance setting restricts the OpenID Connect protocol rather than providing a selective token-encryption control.
claims.quote: Use the parent control to restrict external authentication as a whole, or use the child controls to restrict individual protocols, providers, or local authentication.
claims.fix: Replace the final sentence 'It does not restrict encryption.' with 'This is a protocol control, not a documented encryption-specific switch.' This preserves the documented distinction without suggesting that encrypted-token sign-in could bypass a protocol block.
